scope: Saved numeric provider usage for the 96 selected first-attempt cells in the 16-task specified-repair study.
projection_rule: Allowlisted numeric native totals and per-model fields are copied without alteration. Numeric per-request token fields retain their original names. Each request identifier is replaced by SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Original receipt hashes identify the unmodified internal evidence.
original_usage_object_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with sorted keys and compact separators, using standard JSON string escaping.
native_completeness_definition: A non-null native object is the saved terminal provider usage receipt. A null native object leaves only the recorded per-request usage and is marked incomplete.
